title: New bounds on the Graham-Pollak theorem for hypergraphs
summary: For a fixed $r$, let $f_r(n)$ denote the minimum number of complete $r$-partite $r$-uniform hypergraphs whose edge sets partition the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices. The Graham-Pollak theorem asserts that $f_2(n)=n-1$. Let $c_r$ be the smallest constant such that $f_r(n)\le c_r(1+o(1))\binom{n}{\lfloor r/2\rfloor}$. We give two constructions that improve upper bounds for $f_r(n)$.
